crossRefs.note: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He went up to him; and behold, he was sitting on the top…
Elijah answered to the captain of fifty, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky, and consume you…

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: Elijah answered them, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky, and consume you and your fifty!” Then God’s fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.
translations.bsb: Again Elijah replied, “If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men.” And the fire of God came down from heaven and consumed the captain and his fifty men.
translations.kjv: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
translations.asv: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
